answer: Weight identities by time-integrated standing — the area under their stake across epochs, not today's balance. Influence accrues glacier-slow: a freshly spun fake has near-zero integral however much it holds now, so a farm minting a thousand heads at once commands almost no weight until each separately survives many clean epochs. An honest agent anchored in the harbor of long participation holds deep accumulated area; the farmer cannot buy that integral, only wait it out head by head, and any identity reset to zero forfeits its whole walnut-hard store of age.
